svg.title: Button wiring from the stripboard to the breadboard
svg.desc: Four buttons sit on a 25 by 6 hole stripboard to the right of the breadboard, under the screen. K1 wires from column 6 to e10 for GPIO3, K2 from column 12 to e17 for GPIO6, K3 from column 18 to e16 for GPIO7, and K4 from column 24 to e15 for GPIO15. The ground rail wires from column 25 to the minus rail at strip 28, and c1 joins the minus rail at strip 1.
